name: bench-c-exploration-heldout
description: R1.5 class C, exploration opportunity: several food routines with different risks in view, the learner supervised so the exploration-tolerance channel is live. Horizons are experiment settings chosen against the affect half-lives (unease 1200, valence 6000, control 12000 ticks): short about one valence half-life, medium two control half-lives, long six. HELD OUT: not to be run while a model is being designed; evaluate a finished model once.
